translations.idiomatic: He detached troops toward Wanzai, killed the general Qiu Yixiang and others, and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 三桂使誘降，應奎令子衍慶呈部，部議加應奎左都督，衍慶署都司僉書。

translations.literal: Sangui sent emissaries to entice him to surrender; Yingkui had his son Yanzheng present the letters to the ministry; the ministry recommended advancing Yingkui to Left Commander-in-Chief and appointing Yanzheng acting assistant regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui tried to win him over; Yingkui had his son Yanzheng present the letters to the ministry, which recommended Left Commander-in-Chief for Yingkui and acting assistant regional commander for Yanzheng.

sentences.zh: 尋降敕嘉其忠藎，予世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: Soon an imperial edict praised his loyalty and granted a hereditary baitaruburu hafan rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict praised his loyalty and granted a hereditary baitaruburu hafan rank.

sentences.zh: 十四年，遣游擊楊正元剿棚賊於分宜、新喻，擒斬甚眾，盡毀其巢。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he sent Guerrilla Commander Yang Zhengyuan to suppress shed bandits in Fenyi and Xinyu; many were captured and beheaded and their nests utterly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he sent Guerrilla Commander Yang Zhengyuan against shed bandits in Fenyi and Xinyu; many were killed and their nests destroyed.

sentences.zh: 三桂將揭玉卿犯萬載，遣游擊陳素綸等敗之，斬級千餘；

translations.literal: Sangui's general Jie Yuqing attacked Wanzai; he sent Guerrilla Commander Chen Sulun and others to defeat him and beheaded more than a thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Sangui's general Jie Yuqing attacked Wanzai; he sent Guerrilla Commander Chen Sulun and others to defeat him and take more than a thousand heads;

sentences.zh: 又敗之於白良。

translations.literal: and defeated him again at Bailiang.
translations.idiomatic: and defeated him again at Bailiang.

sentences.zh: 三桂將黃立卿復以三桂書誘降，應奎令子衍祥呈部，部議加應奎軍功一等，衍祥授鴻臚寺少卿。

translations.literal: Sangui's general Huang Liqing again tried to win him with a letter from Sangui; Yingkui had his son Yanxiang present it to the ministry; the ministry recommended adding first-class military merit for Yingkui and appointing Yanxiang Gentleman of the Honglu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui's general Huang Liqing again tried to win him over; Yingkui had his son Yanxiang present the letter; the ministry recommended first-class military merit for Yingkui and Honglu Gentleman for Yanxiang.

sentences.zh: 十五年，遣游擊李顯宗等逐三桂兵至仙居橋、沙溪、湖塘，皆敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he sent Guerrilla Commander Li Xianzong and others to pursue Sangui's troops to Xianju Bridge, Shaxi, and Hutang, defeating them at each place.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he sent Guerrilla Commander Li Xianzong and others to pursue Sangui's troops to Xianju Bridge, Shaxi, and Hutang and defeat them at each place.

sentences.zh: 三桂兵复結瀏陽諸寇陷萬載，應奎進剿，賊截龍河渡口，夾岸迎拒。

translations.literal: Sangui's troops again joined with Liuyang bandits to take Wanzai; Yingkui advanced in suppression; the rebels blocked the Longhe ford and resisted from both banks.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui's troops joined Liuyang bandits to take Wanzai; Yingkui advanced; the rebels held the Longhe ford and resisted from both banks.

sentences.zh: 應奎督兵渡河，先斬守口賊，直入其壘，賊大潰，追斬無算，复萬載，詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: Yingkui led his troops across the river, first beheading the rebels guarding the crossing, then driving straight into their stockade; the rebels broke in great rout and countless were pursued and slain; Wanzai was recovered and an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Yingkui crossed the river, killed the guards at the ford, and drove into their camp; the rebels broke; countless were cut down in pursuit; Wanzai was recovered and the throne praised him.

sentences.zh: 尋授三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Soon he was granted third-class adaha hafan rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he received third-class adaha hafan rank.

sentences.zh: 十七年，上以江西已定，命應奎統本標官兵移鎮茶陵、攸縣。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because Jiangxi was already pacified, Yingkui was ordered to transfer his standard troops to garrison Chaling and You county.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17, with Jiangxi pacified, Yingkui was ordered to move his standard troops to garrison Chaling and You.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「自三桂反，袁州密邇湖南，臣率孤軍征剿，上游幸獲安全。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Since Sangui rebelled, Yuanzhou bordered Hunan closely; Your servant led a solitary army in campaign and suppression, and the upper reaches fortunately remained secure.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Since Sangui rebelled, Yuanzhou lay on Hunan's border; I led a lone army in campaign and the upper reaches stayed secure.

sentences.zh: 但彼時兵力苦單，漕運亦匱，臣捐貲贍養親兵，或自備馬匹，或獎以虛銜。

translations.literal: But at that time our strength was painfully thin and grain transport was also exhausted; Your servant contributed funds to support his personal troops, some providing their own horses or being rewarded with honorary ranks.
translations.idiomatic: But our strength was thin and grain transport failed; I spent my own funds to support personal troops, some providing horses or receiving honorary ranks.

sentences.zh: 嗣戶部侍郎溫岱奏見臣督親丁防禦，蒙恩給臣所養健丁千人步戰兵餉，令臣量為設官管轄。

translations.literal: Later Vice Minister of Revenue Wen Dai memorialized having seen Your servant directing household retainers in defense; we were graced with rations for a thousand foot soldiers for the sturdy men Your servant had raised, and ordered that officers be appointed to command them as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Later Vice Minister Wen Dai reported seeing me lead household troops in defense; we were granted rations for a thousand foot soldiers among the sturdy men I had raised and told to appoint officers to command them.

sentences.zh: 惟兵丁既叨餉餼，而所設管轄官未議實授。

translations.literal: Yet though the soldiers now receive pay, the officers appointed to command them have not been given substantive appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Yet though the soldiers now draw pay, the officers commanding them have not received substantive appointments.

sentences.zh: 今臣移駐茶、攸，僅率標兵二千六百，現奉征南將軍穆佔、定南將軍華善調往酃縣千四百人。

translations.literal: Now that Your servant is transferred to Chaling and You, he leads only twenty-six hundred standard troops, and presently one thousand four hundred men are being detached by Pacification General Mupi and Pacification General Hua Shan to Ling county.
translations.idiomatic: Now at Chaling and You I lead only twenty-six hundred standard troops, and Pacification Generals Mupi and Hua Shan have detached fourteen hundred men to Ling county.

sentences.zh: 健丁一營，隨臣左右。

translations.literal: The sturdy-men battalion accompanies Your servant at his side.
translations.idiomatic: The sturdy-men battalion remains at my side.

sentences.zh: 仰冀天恩，各予實銜，開支實俸。

translations.literal: We humbly hope for heavenly grace that each may receive substantive rank and draw regular salary."
translations.idiomatic: We humbly ask that each may receive substantive rank and regular salary."

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，賊犯永興，敗之。

translations.literal: Before long rebels attacked Yongxing and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Soon rebels attacked Yongxing and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從大將軍簡親王喇布复祁陽、新寧。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he followed Grand General Prince Jian Labu in recovering Qiyang and Xinning.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he followed Grand General Prince Jian Labu in recovering Qiyang and Xinning.

sentences.zh: 大將軍安親王岳樂檄勦賊武岡州楓木嶺，敗三桂將胡國柱等。

translations.literal: Grand General Prince An Yuele ordered suppression of rebels at Fengmuling in Wugang prefecture, and defeated Sangui's general Hu Guozhu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Prince An Yuele ordered suppression at Fengmuling in Wugang and defeated Sangui's general Hu Guozhu and others.

sentences.zh: 尋偕貴州提督趙賴攻克龍頭山、泡洞口、瓦屋塘、雲霧嶺、五子坡諸寨。

translations.literal: Soon together with Guizhou Provincial Commander Zhao Lai he captured the stockades Longtoushan, Paodongkou, Wawutang, Yunwuling, and Wuzipo.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with Guizhou Commander Zhao Lai he took the stockades Longtoushan, Paodongkou, Wawutang, Yunwuling, and Wuzipo.

sentences.zh: 三桂將馬寶敗遁，追擊之，復會同、黔陽等縣。

translations.literal: Sangui's general Ma Bao was defeated and fled; they pursued him and recovered Tonghe, Qianyang, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui's general Ma Bao was beaten and fled; they pursued and recovered Tonghe, Qianyang, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 未幾，建義將軍馬承廕以柳州叛，從簡親王率兵討之，承廕降。

translations.literal: Before long Jianyi General Ma Chengyin rebelled at Liuzhou; Yingkui followed Prince Jian Labu in leading troops against him, and Chengyin surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jianyi General Ma Chengyin rebelled at Liuzhou; Yingkui followed Prince Jian Labu against him, and Chengyin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命以提督充廣西左江鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to serve as provincial military commander of the Zuojiang garrison in Guangxi in the capacity of provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 he was ordered to serve as Zuojiang regional commander in the capacity of provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was recorded, he was advanced to second-class adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: His service was recognized with advancement to second-class adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣昔任思南副將，深知左江為滇、黔門戶，接壤交南，環以僮、瑤，土司不時反覆。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "When Your servant was formerly vice commander of Sinan, he knew well that Zuojiang was the gateway to Yunnan and Guizhou, bordered Annam, and was surrounded by Zhuang and Yao peoples, with native chieftains often shifting between rebellion and submission.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "As former vice commander of Sinan I knew Zuojiang was the gateway to Yunnan and Guizhou, bordered Annam, and was ringed by Zhuang and Yao with chieftains often shifting between rebellion and submission.

sentences.zh: 鎮標額設四營，共兵三千有餘，多從逆歸命者，習成驕悍。

translations.literal: The garrison standard has four battalions with more than three thousand authorized troops, mostly men who had followed the rebels and then submitted; they have grown proud and fierce.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison has four battalions with more than three thousand authorized troops, mostly men who followed the rebels and then submitted; they have grown proud and fierce.

sentences.zh: 臣標健丁一營，半系親屬，久經訓練，請率赴新任，以資鈐壓。

translations.literal: Your servant's sturdy-men battalion is half composed of relatives, long trained; he asks to lead them to the new post to enforce discipline.
translations.idiomatic: My sturdy-men battalion is half kin, long trained; I ask to bring them to the new post to keep order.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以病累疏乞休，詔輒慰留，命衍祥馳驛歸省。

translations.literal: Before long, repeatedly petitioning on grounds of illness to retire, he received repeated edicts of consolation and retention; Yingkui was ordered to send Yanxiang post-haste to visit his home.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he repeatedly petitioned to retire on grounds of illness; edicts repeatedly consoled and kept him on; he was told to send Yanxiang post-haste to visit home.

sentences.zh: 應奎卒，贈太子少保，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: When Yingkui died he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingkui died he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: =趙賴=趙賴，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: =Zhao Lai= Zhao Lai was a man of the Han Chinese Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lai belonged to the Han Chinese Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 父夢彩，事太宗，以監修福陵，授世職二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His father Mengcai served Taizong and, for supervising repair of the Fuling tombs, was granted a hereditary second-class adaha hafan rank.
translations.idiomatic: His father Mengcai served Taizong and, for supervising repair of the Fuling tombs, received a hereditary second-class adaha hafan rank.

sentences.zh: 賴襲職。

translations.literal: Lai inherited the rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lai inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 從謙郡王瓦克達徵叛將薑瓖，以功進一等，並兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Qian Wakeda in campaigning against the rebel Geng Jingzhong and, for merit, was advanced to first class and also given the additional rank of tosoro hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Qian Wakeda against the rebel Geng Jingzhong and, for merit, was advanced to first class and also given tosoro hafan.

sentences.zh: 擢正藍旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commandant of the Han Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice commandant of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，從大將軍順承郡王勒爾錦討吳三桂，擢貴州提督，統兵駐九江，調江西。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he followed Grand General Prince Shuncheng Leerjin against Wu Sangui, was promoted to provincial military commander of Guizhou, commanded troops at Jiujiang, and was transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he followed Grand General Prince Shuncheng Leerjin against Wu Sangui, became Guizhou provincial commander, commanded troops at Jiujiang, and was transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 韓大任陷吉安，賴率兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: Han Daren had taken Ji'an; Lai led troops and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Han Daren had taken Ji'an; Lai led troops and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 復調湖南，從簡親王喇布勦賊衡山，复衡州府。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Hunan and followed Prince Jian Labu in suppressing rebels at Hengshan and recovered Hengzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to Hunan and followed Prince Jian Labu in suppressing rebels at Hengshan and recovered Hengzhou prefecture.

sentences.zh: 迭克耒陽、祁陽等縣。

translations.literal: He successively took Leiyang, Qiyang, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: He took Leiyang, Qiyang, and other counties in succession.

sentences.zh: 敗三桂將吳國貴等，复武岡。

translations.literal: He defeated Sangui's generals Wu Guogui and others and recovered Wugang.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Sangui's generals Wu Guogui and others and recovered Wugang.

sentences.zh: 十九年，從大將軍貝子彰泰、將軍蔡毓榮進攻貴州，迭克賊寨。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he followed Grand General Beile Zhangtai and General Cai Yurong in attacking Guizhou and successively captured rebel stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he followed Grand General Beile Zhangtai and General Cai Yurong into Guizhou and took rebel stockades one after another.

sentences.zh: 敗馬寶於洪江，复黔陽，旋自沅州趨鎮遠，复黎平、銅仁、思州、思南等府。

translations.literal: He defeated Ma Bao at Hongjiang and recovered Qianyang, then marched from Yuanzhou toward Zhenyuan and recovered Liping, Tongren, Sizhou, Sinan, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He beat Ma Bao at Hongjiang and recovered Qianyang, then advanced from Yuanzhou on Zhenyuan and recovered Liping, Tongren, Sizhou, Sinan, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 偕將軍穆佔敗三桂將高啟隆、夏國相等，復平遠府。

translations.literal: Together with General Mupi he defeated Sangui's generals Gao Qilong, Xia Guoxiang, and others and recovered Pingyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: With General Mupi he defeated Sangui's generals Gao Qilong and Xia Guoxiang and recovered Pingyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大軍進徵雲南，詔賴留鎮貴州，擢正藍旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: When the main army advanced into Yunnan, an edict ordered Lai to remain and garrison Guizhou, and he was promoted to commandant of the Han Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army marched into Yunnan, Lai was ordered to remain and garrison Guizhou and was promoted to commandant of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 以老乞休。

translations.literal: On grounds of age he petitioned to retire.
translations.idiomatic: He petitioned to retire on grounds of age.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 31.

sentences.zh: =李芳述=李芳述，四川合州人。

translations.literal: =Li Fangshu= Li Fangshu was a native of Hezhou in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fangshu was a native of Hezhou in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 初入伍，隸貴州大定總兵劉之复標下。

translations.literal: At first he entered military service under Regional Commander Liu Zhifu of the Dading garrison in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered service under Regional Commander Liu Zhifu of the Dading garrison in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 剿水西土司安坤有功，授千總。

translations.literal: He had merit in suppressing the Shuixi chieftain An Kun and was made a chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself suppressing the Shuixi chieftain An Kun and was made a chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，吳三桂反，之復從逆，脅芳述往湖北，據夷陵、巴東關隘。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Wu Sangui rebelled; Zhifu followed him in rebellion and coerced Fangshu to go to Hubei and hold the passes at Yiling and Badong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Wu Sangui rebelled; Zhifu joined him and forced Fangshu to Hubei to hold the passes at Yiling and Badong.

sentences.zh: 芳述脫走，留四川，其妻子在大定。

translations.literal: Fangshu escaped; he remained in Sichuan while his wife and children were at Dading.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshu escaped and stayed in Sichuan while his wife and children remained at Dading.

sentences.zh: 越五年，乃得取妻子至敘州。

translations.literal: After five years he was able to bring his wife and children to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After five years he was able to reunite his family at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 吳世璠加芳述偽總兵，令自巫山襲鄖、襄。

translations.literal: Wu Shifan made Fangshu a fake regional commander and ordered him to strike Xiang and Xiangyang from Wushan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shifan gave Fangshu a fake regional command and ordered him to strike Xiangyang from Wushan.

sentences.zh: 芳述留重慶。

translations.literal: Fangshu remained at Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshu stayed at Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 十九年，勇略將軍趙良棟進取成都，芳述遣人赴軍前呈繳偽劄，率重慶、瀘州、敘州所屬州縣文武吏降。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Valiant General Zhao Liangdong advanced on Chengdu; Fangshu sent men to the army to surrender his false commissions, and led the civil and military officials of Chongqing, Luzhou, Xuzhou, and their subordinate districts in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 Zhao Liangdong advanced on Chengdu; Fangshu sent envoys to surrender his false commissions and brought the officials of Chongqing, Luzhou, Xuzhou, and their districts over to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 良棟令芳述撫永寧，即移軍駐守，修繕城垣。

translations.literal: Liangdong ordered Fangshu to pacify Yongning, then moved his army to garrison there and repair the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Liangdong put Fangshu in charge of Yongning, then moved his army there to garrison and repair the walls.

sentences.zh: 甫竣事，世璠將毛友貴等以數万人來犯，芳述迎擊，賊卻走​​。

translations.literal: Just as the work was finished, Shifan's generals Mao Yougui and others came with tens of thousands; Fangshu met them in battle and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Just as the repairs were finished, Shifan's generals Mao Yougui and others attacked with tens of thousands; Fangshu met them and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 尋以悍卒數千偪城，夜樹雲梯攀堞，芳述督兵鏖戰，斃賊千餘，斬友貴於陣。

translations.literal: Soon fierce troops numbering thousands pressed the city; at night they raised cloud ladders to scale the battlements; Fangshu directed a bitter fight, killed more than a thousand rebels, and beheaded Yougui in the field.
translations.idiomatic: Soon thousands of fierce troops pressed the city and at night raised ladders to the battlements; Fangshu fought bitterly, killed more than a thousand rebels, and slew Yougui in the field.

sentences.zh: 世璠將胡國柱、王邦圖等以顯武將軍印招芳述，芳述封送良棟。

translations.literal: Shifan's generals Hu Guozhu, Wang Bangtu, and others tried to win Fangshu with the seal of Manifest Martial General; Fangshu sealed it and sent it to Liangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan's generals Hu Guozhu and Wang Bangtu tried to win him with the Manifest Martial General seal; Fangshu sealed it and forwarded it to Liangdong.

sentences.zh: 良棟以聞，詔授隨徵總兵。

translations.literal: Liangdong reported it, and an edict appointed Fangshu campaign regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Liangdong reported it, and Fangshu was appointed campaign regional commander.

sentences.zh: 未幾，賊陷仁懷、合江。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels took Renhuai and Hejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebels took Renhuai and Hejiang.

sentences.zh: 芳述移兵守敘州，擒賊諜，斬以徇。

translations.literal: Fangshu moved his troops to guard Xuzhou, captured rebel spies, and executed them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshu moved to guard Xuzhou, captured rebel spies, and executed them as a warning.

sentences.zh: 賊來犯，芳述壁城外真武、翠屏諸山，賊不得逞，潛退馬湖，謀出木川、犍為襲成都。

translations.literal: When rebels came to attack, Fangshu fortified the Zhenwu and Cuiping hills outside the city; the rebels could not prevail and secretly withdrew to Mahu, planning to strike Chengdu by way of Muchuan and Qianwei.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels attacked, Fangshu held the Zhenwu and Cuiping hills outside the city; unable to break through, they withdrew to Mahu and planned to strike Chengdu through Muchuan and Qianwei.

sentences.zh: 芳述詗知之，先率兵至犍為扼其衝，大破賊，躡擊至新增黃茅岡，斬殺過半。

translations.literal: Fangshu learned of this, marched first to Qianwei to block their route, routed them heavily, pursued to Huangmaogang in Xinzeng, and killed more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshu learned of the plan, reached Qianwei first to block them, routed them heavily, and pursued to Huangmaogang in Xinzeng, killing more than half.

sentences.zh: 降其將夏升、羅應甲等，拔被掠民二千有奇。

translations.literal: He accepted the surrender of their generals Xia Sheng, Luo Yingjia, and others, and rescued more than two thousand civilians who had been carried off.
translations.idiomatic: He accepted the surrender of generals Xia Sheng and Luo Yingjia and rescued more than two thousand abducted civilians.

sentences.zh: 擢西寧總兵官，仍從征雲南。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of Xining and still followed the campaign into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander of Xining and continued into Yunnan with the campaign.

sentences.zh: 二十年，良棟令為前鋒，自洪雅、榮經二縣出大象嶺之左，敗賊關山。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Liangdong made him vanguard; he marched out from Hongya and Rongjing counties by the left of Daxiangling and defeated the rebels at Guanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 Liangdong made him vanguard; he marched from Hongya and Rongjing by the left of Daxiangling and defeated the rebels at Guanshan.

sentences.zh: 時國柱踞建昌，聞關山、大象嶺俱失，棄建昌走雲南。

translations.literal: At that time Guozhu held Jianchang; hearing that Guanshan and Daxiangling had both fallen, he abandoned Jianchang and fled to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhu then held Jianchang; hearing that Guanshan and Daxiangling had fallen, he abandoned Jianchang and fled to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 芳述渡金沙江，會良棟軍取雲南，奪得勝橋，拔其東西二營，遂克雲南。

translations.literal: Fangshu crossed the Jinsha River, joined Liangdong's army to take Yunnan, seized Desheng Bridge, took the eastern and western camps, and then captured Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshu crossed the Jinsha, joined Liangdong to take Yunnan, seized Desheng Bridge, took the eastern and western camps, and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，遷貴州提督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to provincial military commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 he became provincial commander of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 四十年，雲南總督巴錫疏劾游擊高鑑，語連芳述徇隱，芳述亦疏訐巴錫，上遣侍郎溫達往讞。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Yunnan Governor-General Ba Xi impeached Guerrilla Commander Gao Jian in terms that implicated Fangshu in concealment; Fangshu also memorialized accusing Ba Xi; the emperor sent Vice Minister Wen Da to try the case.
translations.idiomatic: In year 40 Yunnan Governor-General Ba Xi impeached Guerrilla Commander Gao Jian in a way that implicated Fangshu in concealment; Fangshu memorialized against Ba Xi in turn, and the emperor sent Vice Minister Wen Da to judge the case.

sentences.zh: 芳述應奪俸，免之。

translations.literal: Fangshu should have had his salary confiscated; this was waived.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshu should have lost his salary; the penalty was waived.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，湖南鎮筸紅苗作亂，芳述移兵會剿，深入苗地，平塘山及葫蘆、天星諸寨。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year the Red Miao rebelled at Zhenbi in Hunan; Fangshu moved troops to join the suppression, penetrated deep into Miao country, and pacified Pingtangshan and the Hulu, Tianxing, and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In year 42 the Red Miao rebelled at Zhenbi in Hunan; Fangshu joined the suppression, penetrated deep into Miao territory, and pacified Pingtangshan and the Hulu, Tianxing, and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「貴州苗、民雜處，控制尤在得人。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In Guizhou Miao and settlers are intermixed, and control depends above all on having the right men.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In Guizhou Miao and settlers are intermixed, and control depends above all on the right men.

sentences.zh: 保題武職，請以久任苗地、熟悉風土者揀選題補。

translations.literal: In recommending military officers, please select and appoint men who have long served in Miao country and know local conditions."
translations.idiomatic: In recommending military officers, please select men long stationed in Miao country who know local conditions."

sentences.zh: 」詔允行。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，詔獎「芳述久鎮邊境，馭軍有法。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year an edict praised him: "Fangshu has long garrisoned the frontier and disciplines his troops with method.
translations.idiomatic: In year 45 an edict praised him: "Fangshu has long garrisoned the frontier and commands his troops with discipline.

sentences.zh: 現今舊將，罕與比倫」。

translations.literal: Among old generals today, few can compare with him."
translations.idiomatic: Among veteran generals today, few can compare with him."

sentences.zh: 特加太子少保，授鎮遠將軍。

translations.literal: He was specially made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the rank of Zhenyuan General.
translations.idiomatic: He was specially made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the rank of Zhenyuan General.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，卒，贈太子少傅，諡壯敏，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he died; he was posthumously made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Zhuangmin, and granted state sacrifices and burial.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 47, was posthumously made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Zhuangmin, and received state funeral honors.

sentences.zh: =陳世凱=陳世凱，字贊伯，湖廣恩施人。

translations.literal: =Chen Shikai= Chen Shikai, style name Zanbo, was a native of Enshi in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shikai, style name Zanbo, was a native of Enshi in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 初附明桂王，為忠州副總兵。

translations.literal: At first he attached himself to the Ming Prince of Gui and was vice commander of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He first served the Ming Prince of Gui as vice commander of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，川陝總督李國英駐師重慶，世凱來降，授副將銜。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi, Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Li Guoying was stationed at Chongqing; Shikai came over and was given the rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 16, Governor-General Li Guoying was at Chongqing; Shikai submitted and received vice commander rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，李自成餘黨劉一虎等以數万人犯巫山，世凱擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi, Li Zicheng's remnant Liu Yihu and others came with tens of thousands to attack Wushan; Shikai beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 10, Li Zicheng's remnant Liu Yihu attacked Wushan with tens of thousands; Shikai drove them back.

sentences.zh: 尋從國英進剿，以功加總兵銜。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Guoying in suppression campaigns and, for merit, was given regional commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he followed Guoying on suppression campaigns and, for merit, received regional commander rank.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授杭州副將。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was made vice commander of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he became vice commander of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十三年，耿精忠反，浙江總督李之芳駐師衢州，令世凱援金華。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Geng Jingzhong rebelled; Zhejiang Governor-General Li Zhifang was stationed at Quzhou and ordered Shikai to relieve Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Geng Jingzhong rebelled; Governor-General Li Zhifang was at Quzhou and ordered Shikai to relieve Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 甫渡江，聞寇犯龍遊，即遣兵馳擊，通衢州餉道。

translations.literal: Just as he crossed the river, he heard that bandits were attacking Longyou; he immediately sent troops in haste to strike them and opened the grain route to Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Just as he crossed the river he heard bandits were attacking Longyou; he sent troops at once, beat them back, and opened the grain route to Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 既至金華，精忠將閻標自永康、武義來犯，世凱與副都統沃申御之，發砲擊賊。

translations.literal: After reaching Jinhua, Jingzhong's general Yan Biao came from Yongkang and Wuyi to attack; Shikai and Vice Commandant Wo Shen resisted them and opened fire on the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinhua, Jingzhong's general Yan Biao came from Yongkang and Wuyi; Shikai and Vice Commandant Wo Shen held them off and opened fire on the rebels.

sentences.zh: 既，復與總兵李榮逐賊湯溪，分兵出賊後，而自當其前，獲所置監軍道徐福龍等。

translations.literal: Later he again joined Regional Commander Li Rong in driving the rebels from Tangxi, detached troops to get behind them while he himself blocked their front, and captured their supervising inspector Xu Fulong and others.
translations.idiomatic: Later he joined Regional Commander Li Rong to drive rebels from Tangxi, sent troops around their rear while he blocked the front, and captured supervising inspector Xu Fulong and others.

sentences.zh: 精忠將陳重自東陽、葉鍾自浦江先後來犯，與副都統瑪哈達、石調聲督兵擊之敗走。

translations.literal: Jingzhong's generals Chen Chong came from Dongyang and Ye Zhong from Pujiang to attack in succession; with Vice Commandants Mahada and Shi Diaosheng he directed troops to beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong's generals Chen Chong and Ye Zhong attacked from Dongyang and Pujiang in turn; with Vice Commandants Mahada and Shi Diaosheng he beat them back.

sentences.zh: 援義烏，破精忠將周彪。

translations.literal: He relieved Yiwu and defeated Jingzhong's general Zhou Biao.
translations.idiomatic: He relieved Yiwu and defeated Jingzhong's general Zhou Biao.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授溫州總兵，加都督僉事。

translations.literal: When merit was recorded, he was made regional commander of Wenzhou and Assistant Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was made regional commander of Wenzhou and Assistant Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 精忠將徐尚朝以數万人逼金華，世凱出城南十二里與戰，寇甫集，大呼陷陣，寇潰奔，逐北十餘裡，殺傷過半。

translations.literal: Jingzhong's general Xu Shangchao pressed Jinhua with tens of thousands; Shikai fought him twelve li south of the city; as the enemy were just assembling he shouted and broke the line; the enemy broke and fled; he pursued north more than ten li and killed or wounded more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong's general Xu Shangchao pressed Jinhua with tens of thousands; Shikai met him twelve li south of the city, broke the line with a shout as the enemy assembled, pursued more than ten li, and killed or wounded more than half.

sentences.zh: 尚朝與精忠將馮公輔合，得五萬人，據積道山，立木城石壘。

translations.literal: Shangchao joined with Jingzhong's general Feng Gongfu, gathering fifty thousand men; they held Jidao Mountain and built wooden walls and stone ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: Shangchao joined Feng Gongfu with fifty thousand men, held Jidao Mountain, and built wooden walls and stone ramparts.

sentences.zh: 世凱乘大霧進兵，破木城，斬級萬餘，尚朝敗走。

translations.literal: Shikai advanced in heavy fog, broke the wooden wall, beheaded more than ten thousand, and Shangchao fled.
translations.idiomatic: Shikai advanced in heavy fog, broke the wooden wall, took more than ten thousand heads, and Shangchao fled.

sentences.zh: 大將軍康親王杰書師進次金華，令世凱及瑪哈達、榮規處州。

translations.literal: Grand General Prince Kang Jieshu's army advanced and halted at Jinhua; he ordered Shikai, Mahada, and Rong to garrison Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Prince Kang Jieshu advanced to Jinhua and ordered Shikai, Mahada, and Rong to garrison Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，世凱复永康，進攻縉雲，擊破尚朝兵，克之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Shikai recovered Yongkang, advanced on Jinyun, defeated Shangchao's troops, and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Shikai recovered Yongkang, advanced on Jinyun, defeated Shangchao, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 精忠將沙有祥守處州，壘桃花嶺拒守。

translations.literal: Jingzhong's general Sha Youxiang held Chuzhou and fortified Taohualing to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong's general Sha Youxiang held Chuzhou behind fortifications at Taohualing.

sentences.zh: 世凱等師三道入，奪嶺，有祥走，克處州。

translations.literal: Shikai and others entered in three columns, took the ridge, Youxiang fled, and Chuzhou was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Shikai entered in three columns, took the ridge, Youxiang fled, and Chuzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 尚朝來犯，三戰破賊，獲其裨將，斬八百餘級。

translations.literal: Shangchao came to attack; in three battles they defeated the rebels, captured their lieutenant generals, and beheaded more than eight hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Shangchao attacked again; in three battles they defeated the rebels, captured lieutenant generals, and took more than eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 移師徇松陽，從貝子傅喇塔攻溫州。

translations.literal: He moved his army through Songyang and followed Beile Fulata in attacking Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He moved through Songyang and followed Beile Fulata against Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年，精忠將曾養性及叛將祖弘勳以四萬餘人拒我師，世凱與提督段應舉奮擊，獲其裨將。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Jingzhong's general Zeng Yangxing and the rebel general Zu Hongxun with more than forty thousand men resisted our army; Shikai and Provincial Commander Duan Yingju fought fiercely and captured their lieutenant generals.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 Jingzhong's general Zeng Yangxing and rebel Zu Hongxun resisted with more than forty thousand men; Shikai and Commander Duan Yingju fought fiercely and captured lieutenant generals.

sentences.zh: 詔傅喇塔進徵福建，世凱以所部從。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fulata to advance into Fujian; Shikai followed with his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fulata was ordered into Fujian; Shikai followed with his troops.

sentences.zh: 擊養性得胜山，破其壘。

translations.literal: He attacked Yangxing at Desheng Mountain and broke his stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Yangxing at Desheng Mountain and broke his stockade.

sentences.zh: 寇舟屯江山，督兵擊之，師行乃無阻，復云和、泰順諸縣。

translations.literal: The enemy moored boats at Jiangshan; he directed troops to strike them, and the march went unimpeded; he recovered Yunhe, Taishun, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy held boats at Jiangshan; he struck them and the march went unimpeded; he recovered Yunhe, Taishun, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 精忠降，世凱還鎮溫州。

translations.literal: Jingzhong surrendered; Shikai returned to garrison Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingzhong surrendered, Shikai returned to garrison Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年，加左都督，予世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was made Left Commander-in-Chief and granted a hereditary tosoro hafan rank.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he was made Left Commander-in-Chief and granted a hereditary tosoro hafan rank.

sentences.zh: 屢招降鄭錦將陳彬、劉天福等。

translations.literal: He repeatedly induced Zheng Chenggong's generals Chen Bin, Liu Tianfu, and others to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly won over Zheng Chenggong's generals Chen Bin, Liu Tianfu, and others.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，進拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was advanced to baitaruburu hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he was advanced to baitaruburu hafan.

sentences.zh: 朝京師，上獎其績，諭「輯兵愛民，毋以功大生驕傲」，賜鞍馬、裘服。

translations.literal: He had audience in the capital; the emperor praised his record and instructed him, "Keep your troops in order and love the people; do not grow proud because your merit is great," and granted saddle horses and fur robes.
translations.idiomatic: At audience in the capital the emperor praised his record and told him, "Keep your troops in order and love the people; do not grow proud because your merit is great," and granted saddle horses and fur robes.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢浙江提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was promoted to provincial military commander of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he became provincial commander of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上製聖訓十六條，宣諭士民。

translations.literal: The emperor composed the Sixteen Maxims of the Sacred Edict and proclaimed them to officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed the Sixteen Maxims of the Sacred Edict and proclaimed them to officials and people.

sentences.zh: 世凱請令將卒一體講讀，並援引經史依類附註，為書三卷，奏進頒行。

translations.literal: Shikai asked that officers and soldiers alike study them, cited classics and histories by category with notes, made a book in three juan, and memorialized it for promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: Shikai asked that officers and soldiers study them together, compiled annotated excerpts from the classics and histories in three juan, and memorialized the work for promulgation.

sentences.zh: 又奏春秋祭文廟，宜令武職行禮。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that at the spring and autumn sacrifices at the Confucian temple, military officers should perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that military officers perform the spring and autumn rites at the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 下九卿議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the Nine Ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers deliberated and approved.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，复朝京師，命還任，以疾未行，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he again had audience in the capital, was ordered to return to his post, but died before setting out on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he had audience again, was ordered back to his post, but died of illness before he could depart.

sentences.zh: 遣內大臣佟國維、侍衛馬武奠茶酒，賜祭葬，諡襄敏。

translations.literal: Inner Minister Tong Guowei and Guard Ma Wu were sent to offer libations; he was granted state sacrifices and burial with the posthumous name Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Minister Tong Guowei and Guard Ma Wu offered libations; he received state funeral honors and the posthumous name Xiangmin.

sentences.zh: 字天培，授都司。

translations.literal: His style name was Tianpei; he was appointed regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: His son, style name Tianpei, was appointed regional commander.

sentences.zh: 累遷至浙江提督。

translations.literal: He rose in due course to provincial military commander of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to provincial commander of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 世凱勇敢善戰，所向有功，軍中呼為陳鐵頭。

translations.literal: Shikai was brave and skilled in battle, victorious wherever he went; in the army he was called Ironhead Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Shikai was brave and skilled in battle and victorious wherever he went; the army called him Ironhead Chen.

sentences.zh: 浙中諸將，佐之芳戡亂者，又有李榮、王廷梅、牟大寅、鮑虎、蔣懋勳。

translations.literal: Among Zhejiang generals who assisted Zhifang in suppressing rebellion were also Li Rong, Wang Tingmei, Mou Dayin, Bao Hu, and Jiang Maoxun.
translations.idiomatic: Other Zhejiang generals who helped Zhifang suppress the rebellion included Li Rong, Wang Tingmei, Mou Dayin, Bao Hu, and Jiang Maoxun.

sentences.zh: 榮，字華庵，廣寧人。

translations.literal: Rong, style name Hua'an, was a native of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Rong, style name Hua'an, was from Guangning.

sentences.zh: 黃岩總兵。

translations.literal: Regional commander of Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: He was regional commander of Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 廷梅，順天人。

translations.literal: Tingmei was a native of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Tingmei was from Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 武進士。

translations.literal: A military jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He was a military jinshi.

sentences.zh: 自督標中營副將遷平陽總兵。

translations.literal: He was transferred from vice commander of the commander's central battalion to regional commander of Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vice commander of the commander's central battalion to regional commander of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 大寅，湖廣人。

translations.literal: Dayin was a native of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Dayin was from Huguang.

sentences.zh: 鎮海總兵。

translations.literal: Regional commander of Zhenhai.
translations.idiomatic: He was regional commander of Zhenhai.

sentences.zh: 虎，字云樓，山西應州人。

translations.literal: Hu, style name Yunlou, was a native of Yingzhou in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Hu, style name Yunlou, was from Yingzhou in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 初授南贛鎮標前營游擊。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed guerrilla commander of the forward battalion of the Nangan garrison standard.
translations.idiomatic: He was first guerrilla commander of the Nangan garrison forward battalion.

sentences.zh: 擊李成棟有功，累遷浙江嚴州城守副將。

translations.literal: He had merit attacking Li Chengdong and rose in due course to vice commander defending Yancheng in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself against Li Chengdong and rose to vice commander defending Yancheng in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 從之芳禦精忠，克壽昌。

translations.literal: He followed Zhifang against Jingzhong and took Shouchang.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Zhifang against Jingzhong and took Shouchang.

sentences.zh: 破土寇黃應茂。

translations.literal: He broke the local bandit Huang Yingmao.
translations.idiomatic: He broke the local bandit Huang Yingmao.

sentences.zh: 尋代榮為黃岩總兵。

translations.literal: Soon he replaced Rong as regional commander of Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he replaced Rong as regional commander of Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 懋勳，浙江臨海人。

translations.literal: Maoxun was a native of Linhai in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Maoxun was from Linhai in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 溫州總兵。

translations.literal: Regional commander of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was regional commander of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 諡襄僖。

translations.literal: Posthumous title Xiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous title Xiangxi.

sentences.zh: =許占魁=許占魁，字文元，陝西蒲城人，流寓遼東。

translations.literal: =Xu Zhankui= Xu Zhankui, style name Wenyuan, was a native of Pucheng in Shaanxi who had settled in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhankui, style name Wenyuan, was from Pucheng in Shaanxi but had settled in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從豫親王多鐸定江南，授陝西陽平關參將。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed Prince Dorgon of Yu in pacifying Jiangnan and was made assistant commander of Yangping Pass in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he followed Prince Dorgon of Yu in pacifying Jiangnan and was made assistant commander of Yangping Pass in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 六年，土寇趙榮貴擁明宗人森滏號秦王，聚數万人犯階州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the local bandit Zhao Ronggui supported a Ming clansman Senbi styled Prince of Qin, gathered tens of thousands, and attacked Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the bandit Zhao Ronggui backed a Ming clansman Senbi styled Prince of Qin, gathered tens of thousands, and attacked Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 占魁從間道出碧魚口襲其後，先與定西將軍李國翰、臨鞏總兵王允久期夾擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Zhankui by a hidden route came out at Biyukou to strike their rear; he had first arranged with Pacification General Li Guohan of Dingxi and Regional Commander Wang Yunjiu of Lingong to attack from both sides, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui took a hidden route through Biyukou to strike their rear, coordinated with Pacification General Li Guohan and Regional Commander Wang Yunjiu for a pincer, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 遷山西平陽副將。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice commander of Pingyang in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commander of Pingyang in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 土寇張武挾硃秀唐號魏王，掠聞喜。

translations.literal: The local bandit Zhang Wu backed Zhu Xiutang styled Prince of Wei and plundered Wenxi.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Zhang Wu backed Zhu Xiutang styled Prince of Wei and plundered Wenxi.

sentences.zh: 占魁與游擊苗成龍等分道搜剿，戰紫家峪，擒秀唐等，斬級百餘。

translations.literal: Zhankui and Guerrilla Commander Miao Chenglong and others searched and suppressed by separate routes; at Zijia Valley they fought, captured Xiutang and others, and beheaded more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui and Guerrilla Commander Miao Chenglong hunted them on separate routes, fought at Zijia Valley, captured Xiutang and others, and took more than a hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 累調直隸紫荊關副將。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly transferred to vice commander of Zijing Pass in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commander of Zijing Pass in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，擢延綏總兵，駐榆林。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi he was promoted to regional commander of Yan-sui and stationed at Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 9 he became regional commander of Yan-sui and was stationed at Yulin.

sentences.zh: 十三年，提督王輔臣、副將硃龍俱叛應吳三桂，占魁舉首龍所與逆書，上嘉之，下部議敘，加都督同知。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Provincial Commander Wang Fuchen and Vice Commander Zhu Long both rebelled in support of Wu Sangui; Zhankui presented the treasonous letters Long had given him; the emperor praised this, the ministry deliberated on his merit, and he was made Assistant Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Commander Wang Fuchen and Vice Commander Zhu Long rebelled with Wu Sangui; Zhankui presented Long's treasonous letters, the emperor praised him, and he was made Assistant Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 延綏標兵多應調徵四川，龍等窺榆林防守單弱，屢糾眾來犯。

translations.literal: Most of the Yan-sui standard troops had been detached for the Sichuan campaign; Long and others saw that Yulin's defense was thin and repeatedly gathered forces to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Most Yan-sui troops had been sent to Sichuan; Long and others saw Yulin was weakly defended and attacked repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 占魁遣副將張國彥、孫維統，游擊謝鴻儒、錢應龍等分道堵剿，自督兵擊賊綏德。

translations.literal: Zhankui sent Vice Commanders Zhang Guoyan and Sun Weitong and Guerrilla Commanders Xie Hongru and Qian Yinglong to block and suppress on separate routes, while he himself led troops to strike the rebels at Suide.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui sent Vice Commanders Zhang Guoyan and Sun Weitong and Guerrilla Commanders Xie Hongru and Qian Yinglong on separate routes while he struck the rebels at Suide.

sentences.zh: 賊踞城以拒，發砲，斃賊數百。

translations.literal: The rebels held the city to resist; cannon fire killed several hundred rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the city; cannon fire killed several hundred.

sentences.zh: 占魁慮賊襲榆林，率維統等還守榆林，令國彥守波羅堡。

translations.literal: Zhankui feared the rebels would raid Yulin; he led Weitong and others back to defend Yulin and ordered Guoyan to hold Boluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing a raid on Yulin, Zhankui returned with Weitong to defend the city and left Guoyan at Boluo Fort.

sentences.zh: 龍誘波羅營千總劉尚勇等叛，逼國彥，劫奪敕印。

translations.literal: Long induced Boluo garrison chiliarch Liu Shangyong and others to rebel, pressed Guoyan, and seized the imperial commission and seal.
translations.idiomatic: Long won over Boluo chiliarch Liu Shangyong and others, pressed Guoyan, and seized the imperial commission and seal.

sentences.zh: 國彥闔門自焚死。

translations.literal: Guoyan and his entire household burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: Guoyan and his whole household burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 叛將孫崇雅戕神木道楊三知、知縣孫世譽、守備張光斗等，遂踞神木，勢張甚。

translations.literal: The rebel general Sun Chongya killed Circuit Intendant Yang Sanzhi of Shenmu, Magistrate Sun Shiyu, Garrison Commandant Zhang Guangdou, and others, then seized Shenmu; their power grew greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel Sun Chongya killed Shenmu Circuit Intendant Yang Sanzhi, Magistrate Sun Shiyu, Garrison Commandant Zhang Guangdou, and others, seized Shenmu, and grew very powerful.

sentences.zh: 占魁遣子登隆詣闕告急，詔授登隆鴻臚寺少卿，趣將軍畢力克圖、都統覺和托自大同移師赴援。

translations.literal: Zhankui sent his son Denglong to the capital to report the emergency; an edict appointed Denglong Gentleman of the Honglu Temple and urged General Biliktue and Grand Secretary Jiaohetuo to move troops from Datong to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui sent his son Denglong to report the emergency; Denglong was made Honglu Gentleman and Generals Biliktue and Jiaohetuo were urged to march from Datong.

sentences.zh: 占魁遣維統、應龍等從覺和托擊賊，擒斬無算。

translations.literal: Zhankui sent Weitong, Yinglong, and others to strike the rebels with Jiaohetuo; countless were captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui sent Weitong and Yinglong with Jiaohetuo against the rebels; countless were captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 复魚河、響水、波羅諸堡，進克神木。

translations.literal: He recovered the forts of Yuhe, Xiangshui, and Boluo and advanced to take Shenmu.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Yuhe, Xiangshui, Boluo, and other forts and took Shenmu.

sentences.zh: 畢力克圖复綏德、延安，擒崇雅、尚勇等，悉誅之。

translations.literal: Biliktue recovered Suide and Yan'an and captured Chongya, Shangyong, and others; all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Biliktue recovered Suide and Yan'an, captured Chongya and Shangyong, and executed them all.

sentences.zh: 國彥、三知等並賜卹，從征將弁敕議敘。

translations.literal: Guoyan, Sanzhi, and the others were all granted posthumous compensation, and the officers who had campaigned were ordered to have their merit recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Guoyan, Sanzhi, and the others received posthumous compensation, and campaigning officers were ordered recorded for merit.

sentences.zh: 占魁疏言：「王輔臣嗾硃龍竊踞定邊，遂陷綏德、米脂、葭州、神木，賊騎至歸德堡，北距榆林僅二十里。

translations.literal: Zhankui memorialized: "Wang Fuchen incited Zhu Long to seize Dingbian and then take Suide, Mizhi, Jiazhou, and Shenmu; rebel horsemen reached Guide Fort, only twenty li north of Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui memorialized: "Wang Fuchen incited Zhu Long to seize Dingbian and then Suide, Mizhi, Jiazhou, and Shenmu; rebel cavalry reached Guide Fort, only twenty li north of Yulin.

sentences.zh: 臣集闔城官民誓死守城。

translations.literal: Your servant gathered the officials and people of the whole city and swore to defend the walls to the death.
translations.idiomatic: I gathered the city's officials and people and swore to hold the walls to the death.

sentences.zh: 嗣因臨洮、鞏昌、延安、慶陽、平涼、漢中、興安、固原相率從逆，榆林一城獨存，餉道隔絕，百姓日食糠秕。

translations.literal: Then Lintao, Gongchang, Yan'an, Qingyang, Pingliang, Hanzhong, Xing'an, and Guyuan successively followed the rebels; Yulin alone remained, the supply route was cut off, and the people ate bran daily.
translations.idiomatic: Then Lintao, Gongchang, Yan'an, Qingyang, Pingliang, Hanzhong, Xing'an, and Guyuan joined the rebels; Yulin alone held out, supplies were cut, and people ate bran daily.

sentences.zh: 臣斥貲購米，計口授食。

translations.literal: Your servant spent his own funds to buy grain and issued rations by head.
translations.idiomatic: I spent my own funds to buy grain and rationed it by head.

sentences.zh: 及大兵既至，道臣高光祉籌措糧需，將士奮勇擊賊，剋期奏凱，危城得安。

translations.literal: When the main army arrived, Circuit Intendant Gao Guangzhi provisioned grain; officers and soldiers fought bravely against the rebels and victory was achieved on schedule, so the endangered city was saved.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, Circuit Intendant Gao Guangzhi provisioned grain; officers and soldiers fought bravely and victory came on schedule, saving the endangered city.

sentences.zh: 皆由文武同心，兵民合力。

translations.literal: All this was because civil and military officials were of one mind and soldiers and people united their strength.
translations.idiomatic: This was because civil and military officials stood together and soldiers and people united.

sentences.zh: 其在城各官勞績，祈敕部覈議，為固守孤城者勸。

translations.literal: I ask that the ministry examine and reward the merit of every official who was in the city, to encourage those who hold isolated cities firm."
translations.idiomatic: I ask the ministry to examine and reward every official in the city, to encourage those who hold isolated cities firm."

sentences.zh: 」上俞之，俱命優敘。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this; all were ordered specially rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved; all received special rewards.

sentences.zh: 占魁進左都督，予世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: Zhankui was advanced to Left Commander-in-Chief and granted a hereditary baitaruburu hafan rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui was advanced to Left Commander-in-Chief and granted a hereditary baitaruburu hafan rank.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾乞罷，溫旨慰留。

translations.literal: Soon he petitioned to resign on grounds of illness; a warm edict consoled and kept him on.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he asked to resign on grounds of illness; a warm edict consoled him and kept him on.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擢鑾儀使。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to Director of the Imperial Procession.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he was made Director of the Imperial Procession.

sentences.zh: 占魁復以病辭，允馳驛回籍，仍食俸。

translations.literal: Zhankui again pleaded illness; he was allowed to return home by post relay while still drawing salary.
translations.idiomatic: Zhankui pleaded illness again; he was allowed to return home by courier post while still drawing salary.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子少保，賜祭葬視一品，諡恪敏。

translations.literal: When he died he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted obsequies and burial as for first rank, with the posthumous name Kemin.
translations.idiomatic: When he died he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, received first-rank funeral honors, and was named Kemin.

sentences.zh: 子登隆，官至雲南臨安知府。

translations.literal: His son Denglong rose to prefect of Lin'an in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Denglong rose to prefect of Lin'an in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 論曰：順治初，漢兵降，猶分隸漢軍；

translations.literal: The commentator says: At the beginning of Shunzhi, when Han troops surrendered they were still assigned to the Han Banners;
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Early in Shunzhi, surrendered Han troops were still assigned to the Han Banners;

sentences.zh: 其後撫定諸行省，設提鎮，置營汛，於是有綠營。

translations.literal: afterward, as the provinces were pacified and settled, provincial commanders and regional commanders were established with garrisons and posts, and thus came the Green Standard Army.
translations.idiomatic: later, as the provinces were pacified, provincial and regional commanders were established with garrisons and posts, and the Green Standard Army came into being.

sentences.zh: 以綠營當大敵，建愬定之績，自三籓之役始。

translations.literal: That the Green Standard Army should meet great enemies and win signal pacification dates from the Three Feudatories campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army meeting great enemies and winning signal victories dates from the Three Feudatories campaign.

sentences.zh: 蔡毓榮、趙良棟將綠營直下雲南諸行省，以戰伐顯者，如國祚輩，皆彰彰有名氏，而治都、芳述功尤著。

translations.literal: Cai Yurong and Zhao Liangdong led Green Standard troops straight down through the provinces of Yunnan; those who won fame in war, like Guozuo and his peers, are all well-known names, while Zhidou and Fangshu were especially distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yurong and Zhao Liangdong led Green Standard troops through Yunnan's provinces; warriors of renown like Guozuo are household names, while Zhidou and Fangshu were especially distinguished.

sentences.zh: 貞治屯墾，奮起效績，不煩餉運，蓋更有難能者。

translations.literal: Zhen opened military colonies and rose to serve with zeal without troubling grain transport — a still harder achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen opened military colonies and served with zeal without troubling grain transport — a still harder achievement.

sentences.zh: 腹心爪牙，由此其選矣。

translations.literal: Trusted lieutenants were chosen from such men.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty's trusted lieutenants were chosen from such men.
